scalars.scalar_value: Minimum 2 years of customer service experience

items.item_text: High School Diploma
Bachelor’s Degree
Minimum 2 years of customer service experience
1 year of office experience
Assist in securing grade entries from all faculty and entering grades into Student Information System
External transcript evaluation and articulation of external credit into Student Information System
Coordinate with faculty, program directors, and department chairs to ensure timely section creation for each semester’s section offering
Communicate with program directors and appropriate academic committees to create new courses
Communicate with staff and faculty to ensure timely completion of catalog edits each year
Maintain and create course class offerings in Colleague for each semester.
Monitor course enrollments and alert faculty and leaders about the need to add or cancel classes.
Work closely with program assistants, faculty, and staff to ensure that all relevant course and section material is entered on time
Communicates clearly, listens attentively, and seeks to understand others
Serve as a resource to students, faculty, staff, and general public by providing accurate information related to student records, registration and university policies and procedures
Accurately maintain university databases and systems information
Attend regional campus events to assist and represent the Registrar’s Office, such as enrollment express, commencement, orientation, and other events as needed
Clearly explain university policies to faculty, students, and staff
Develop and maintain physical and electronic student records and files
Support Senior Registrar Coordinator with projects
Answering incoming phone calls coming through the main Registrar’s Office phone number; outgoing calls and follow up
Troubleshooting errors or student/faculty/staff difficulties with Registrar processes
Updating information in Colleague as requested through Student Information Update forms and filing in Etrieve

Pulling and sometimes editing various Informer reports to gather information for specific dates/details that pertain to certain forms, obtain various student information, attendance records, active degree applications
Complete dropping/closing waitlists, withdrawal, status changes, updating of enrollment/status, and re-enrollment process in Colleague
Work closely with the Associate Registrar to support articulation efforts of the university
Responsible for development, maintenance and implementation for specific transfer/articulation projects and systems
Develop and maintain physical and electronic student records and files
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students and colleagues in a context of a Christian University, integrating your Christian faith into your role and responsibilities.

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea ”
Uphold and advance Fresno Pacific University’s commitment to Christ-centered higher education, holistic student development, and serving diverse communities.
Complete tasks timely with work that is comprehensive, complete, and accurate
Communicates clearly, listens attentively, and seeks to understand others
Collaborates productively with colleagues of varying skillset
Other job duties as assigned
Detail oriented and able to develop new ideas and create a plan of action
Training and understanding of Colleague software or a similar SIS
Indoors in a normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, fumes, vibrations, and temperature changes at least eighty percent (80%) of the time.
Frequent computer use at a workstation, up to eight hours per day.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Drive personal or University vehicles to appointments.
Public contact position requiring professional apparel, personal hygiene, and grooming.
This position typically functions indoors in an office environment with light to moderate noise associated with business office equipment. The position may involve travel for meetings and events.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Excellent communication and team skills
Developed project management skills
Proven ability to bring projects to completion
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple requests and handle them in an efficient and expedited manner
Knowledge of FERPA requirements and other applicable laws
Proficiency and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word software packages
Ability to build campus relations to expedite work and projects

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: remain in a stationary position 80 % of the time, be able to move about inside the office to access file cabinets/office machinery etc., operate a computer and keyboard and other office productivity machinery such as calculators/copy machines/printers. The employee is occasionally required to position self to reach items on the floor and in high cabinetry.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
